description: This file defines the ProductOptionValueService interface, which declares methods for managing product option values, including CRUD operations and retrieval by various criteria within an e-commerce system.

classes.name: ProductOptionValueService
classes.description: Service interface for operations related to ProductOptionValue entities, including saving, updating, and retrieving by various criteria within a store context.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new ProductOptionValue or updates an existing one, throws ServiceException on failure.

methods.name: getByName
methods.description: Retrieves a list of ProductOptionValues by name within a specific merchant store and language, throws ServiceException if issues occur.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a ProductOptionValue by store and ID, throws ServiceException if retrieval fails.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists all ProductOptionValues for a store and language.

methods.name: listByStoreNoReadOnly
methods.description: Lists all ProductOptionValues for a store and language, excluding read-only entries.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ProductOptionValue by store and code.
